about_the_game:
They are coming...

You play as Tommy, a 9 year old boy who finds himself in a mysterious video game club from the 1990s. Your only goal is to enjoy the arcade machines and have fun But something strange is waiting for you here... Something far beyond what Tommy has ever experienced...

Weird noises echo around you, and to escape this nightmare, you must enter a strange video game. This game not only challenges you with 2D platforming obstacles but also forces you to solve complex puzzles and face the deepest fears within you.

With captivating 3D realistic graphics and a gripping storyline, THEM blends first-person Psychological horror with retro 2D-Platformer gameplay, creating a unique experience.

Are you ready to face them?

Features :

• First-person gameplay + 2D platforming elements

• A deep and captivating story with unexpected twists

• Engaging and mysterious 3D environments

• Find Hidden objects

• Diverse Puzzles

Join THEM and see if you can escape this nightmare or will you become a part of them!
